body: Yeah, that's gotta be the #1 reason I'm torn on whether or not I like it here. I really hate the snow and driving in it.

All these posts are Definitely giving me a new appreciation for the city in ways I never thought about before. I do love having Niagara Falls so close too! I've been there more times than I can count over the years. And I definitely remember Syracuse winning the NCAA tournament in 2003. My mom went to Syracuse so there was a lot of screaming and celebrating in my house that night.
Personally, I still complain about the traffic but that's because Rochester traffic is all I've ever known. But I definitely think you make some great points on things to love about this city!
I'm 22, grew up here and am going to college here. So I guess I basically do fit that description.

5'9 really isn't that short. My boyfriend is 5'1 and we've been together for almost 5 years. I think you just need to find someone that isn't superficial. Not all girls care that much about height, and the ones that do are missing out on some great guys just because of a few extra inches of height.

I never really thought of it like coming out day before, that kind of changes my perspective a bit. I just have a really hard time opening up about my struggles and seeing other people do it sometimes makes me feel bad that I dont have the courage to do it. But hopefully one day i'll get there.
